description: List workspaces across one or all instances, with the same filters. public lists a workspace when its instance has public reading on, the workspace is not private, its instance is listed in Discover and not frozen, and it holds a page that is not private. my and my_admin list the caller's own workspaces with no such gate; all is public plus my. Without a token every filter is public.
name: discovery.list_workspaces
